recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not make the extension occurrence itself required unless a future Vocab decision explicitly requests a breaking conformance change for specific extension usages.
issue_request: FHIR-30575 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request for R5 asking to make the single element in a list of ValueSet-related extensions required. The final Jira discussion states the request came from misunderstanding extension summary cardinalities: the extension occurrence cardinality can be optional while the value or child content is already required when present.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-30575 was found in the core or Extension Pack history. Jira comments first noted in February 2022 that the listed extension values were already 1..1, and the August 2022 Vocab tracker follow-up updated the ticket to applied after concluding it did not need source application.
additional_context: Current core source has no ValueSet extension StructureDefinition files; R5 history removed those extension definitions from core, and the maintained current definitions are in the FHIR Extension Pack. Representative and scripted checks of those definitions show optional extension occurrence cardinalities paired with required value[x] payloads or required named child extensions, which is the intended extension modeling pattern. Confluence minutes corroborate the original Persuasive vote and the later applied-without-edit disposition; no conflicting Zulip or Confluence FTS evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch and made no source changes. Changing the listed extension root cardinalities to 1..1 would incorrectly require every profile using those extensions to include them, while the content inside the extension is already required where current definitions exist.
